content: Tayri n Arebbi s Lmasiḥ deg wuřawen nneɣ
Xenni neccin, am nettwasegged s l’iman, aqa ad ɣarneɣ yiři řehna ak-d AREBBI s Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Maɣar zzayes idweř aneɣ-dd adaf s l’iman ɣar arḍa-ya min di nbedd, u nessemɣar deg usitem n uɛuǧi n AREBBI.
Maca war iǧi di man aya waha, maca nessemɣar ɛawed di řemḥayem, nessen belli řmeḥnet tᵉttaru-dd dayneɣ ṣṣbar,
d ṣṣbar ad yawi taqeǧebt, uca taqeǧebt ad tawi asitem,
uca asitem war ittseḥcim ca, minzi tayri n AREBBI aqa tᵉttwafarreɣ deg wuřawen nneɣ s Arruḥ Iqeddsen i d aneɣ immewcen.
Di ssibbet n tuḍɛeft nneɣ, aqa immut Lmasiḥ di řweqt-a di ṭṭweɛ n iɛeffanen.
S řweḥřan ad immet ḥed di ṭṭweɛ n ijj n uɛeffan, maca di ṭṭweɛ n iṣebḥanen ad taɣ izemmar ad izɛem ḥed ad immet.
Di man aya imřa aneɣ AREBBI tayri nnes, aqa Lmasiḥ immut di ṭṭweɛ nneɣ umi tuɣa aneɣ ɛad d imednab.
Mecḥař ktar aqa nettwasegged řexxu s Idammen nnes uca nettwafekk zzayes zeg weɣḍab!
Minzi řami d aneɣ tuɣa d řɛedyan, ijja AREBBI ad isseṣřeḥ Ixef nnes akidneɣ s řmewt n Mmis, mecḥař qaɛ řexxu ad neddar s Tudart nnes, awarni řami zzayes nufa aṣřaḥ.
U war iǧi man aya waha, maca ad nessemɣar di AREBBI ɛawed s Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, wenni zi neksi řexxu aṣřaḥ.
Adam d Lmasiḥ
Maɣar am mammec s yijj n bnadem yudef-dd ddenb ɣar ddunect uca s ddenb tudef-dd řmewt, ammu dd-tudef řmewt ɣar iwdan marra, minzi xḍan marra.
Minzi qbeř ma tuɣa teǧa Ccariɛa, tuɣa ddenb di ddunect, maca ddenb war ittwaḥsib ca minzi war din teǧi Ccariɛa.
Maca řmewt tuɣa teḥkem zi Adam ař Musa uřa x yinni war ixḍin di ṣṣifet n uxeṭṭu i zi ixḍa Adam ak-d ccariɛa. Adam wenni d ṣṣifet n Wenni dd ɣa yasen.

Maca am mammec teǧi tmesřact s uweṭṭu, ammu war teǧi s tewhibt n arḍa. Minzi mařa mmuten aṭṭas x ssibbet n ijj n uxeṭṭu, mecḥař qaɛ i ɣa ifeyyeḍ arḍa n AREBBI d tewhibt nnes i waṭṭas s uyenni n Bnadem nni, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Tawhibt s arḍa war tᵉttiři am uxeṭṭu n yijjen. S minzi řḥukm yiwi-dd lḥisab zeg ijj n uxeṭṭu, maca tawhibt n arḍa tiwi-dd zeg waṭṭas n ddnub ɣar tsegda.
Minzi mařa s uxeṭṭu n ijjen aqa teḥkem řmewt, mecḥař qaɛ i ɣa ḥekmen di Tudart inni iksin afeyyeḍ n arḍa d tewhibt n tsegda s uyenni n bnadem nni, aqa-t d Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Am mammec xenni s uxeṭṭu n ijjen, aqa idweř řḥukm i marra iwdan, ammu i ɣa tiři řeṣfayet ikemmřen i Tudart i marra iwdan s tsegda n Yijjen.
Minzi am s řmuɛṣiyyet n ijj n bnadem dewřen aṭṭas d imednab, ammu ɛawed s ṭṭaɛet n Ijjen ad dewřen aṭṭas d imseggaden.
Maca umi dd-tusa Ccariɛa, immarni ddenb, u mani immarni ddenb, immarni arḍa aṭṭas s waṭṭas,
ḥima, am mammec iḥkem ddenb ař řmewt, ad iḥkem arḍa ɛawed s tsegda ař Tudart ittduman s Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
